"The Bats" have traditionally struggled on the road, which remains their main headache. The team's leader in attack is Hugo Duro, on whom their sharpness in front of Espanyol's goal will depend.

  • Valencia's last away win: November 2019.

Espanyol vs. Valencia: Prediction and Betting Tips for 23.09.2025

Considering Espanyol's excellent form at their home ground and Valencia's chronic problems in away matches, the hosts are the logical favorites. The Catalans will look to control possession and capitalize on their chances. Valencia will likely build their game on counter-attacks. The absence of Milla for the hosts could affect their scoring ability, so a blowout is not expected.

Lecce approaches the cup match without the pressure that accompanies league games. Understanding that Milan will not field their first-choice team, the visitors will aim to seize their chance. The Giallorossi will likely build their game on a tight defense, relying on fast counter-attacks where striker Nikola Krstović will be the main threat. A match against a giant is the best stage to make a statement.

The history of encounters at the San Siro is overwhelmingly in AC Milan's favor. However, the cup format is famous for its surprises, and underestimating the opponent could be costly for the favorite. Lecce will try to break their dismal statistical record.

  • Lecce's last win at the San Siro: Dates back to October 1997, making this a monumental task.
  • Overall Serie A trend at home: AC Milan regularly defeats Lecce on their home turf, often by a comfortable margin.
  • Key factor: The lineups will be far from optimal, which increases the chances of an unpredictable result.

However, Milan's defense in an experimental combination might make a mistake, which the visitors will try to exploit.
